text:
I wrote the map to `past-work-map/map.md` in my task dir and committed it as `642a6b49e`, staging only that file.

- **Per-directory logs:** The per-directory `ai/` folder idea was built and documented on 2026-10-08, in `ai/doc/design/module-ai-dirs.md`. There are 26 such folders with 295 log lines. They only record that a session or task touched the folder, not what happened.
- **Tagging:** Refine has produced 1,224 asks, but only from 4 of the 7,463 transcript files. Their `module` field is a free-text label, and no `classes` field exists anywhere.
- **Related sessions:** The Related tab on a session page lists that session's own parts. No module page or AI tab lists the sessions that touched a module, though `SessionIndex` can already filter tasks by module.

Item B is answered in `sessions-data/answers.md` (5 sections, with evidence), committed as `5ea75dd47`, touching only my task dir.

1. **Unified tree:** yes. `ai/sessions/` holds 40,293 files, with 582 session folders under `2026/10/`. Old `ai/YYYY-MM-DD/` folders were moved into the store, and I did not count what remains outside it.
2. **Append logs:** no `session.jsonl` exists in the repo. The real logs are `task.jsonl` (1,599 files), `day.jsonl` (46), `cache.jsonl` (11,379), and `files.jsonl` (1,318), with field counts in the file.
3. **SDK path:** `open_task` in `Agents.js` writes an `assign` line with `session_id`. Of 1,585 task files dated since 10-01, 1,487 are spawned and 98 are manual.
4. **Task system:** `TaskDirs.mjs` is real and has about 22 callers, and `append.mjs` validates lines. Nothing counts `finish-task` invocations, so its usage is unmeasured.
5. **Index:** `session-index.json` exists (2,707 sessions). The page loads `sessions.json`, or in remote mode asks the node side for visible rows only. It also runs a 30 s `setInterval`, which conflicts with the stream-not-poll rule.

Left-behind items reach the owner only if the agent itself calls `card_ask` or `owner_note`. The text is otherwise kept in the task's outcome and the parent's `inbox.jsonl`, and no board row shows it. The trace is in `answer.md`, committed as `c8ed18eb0`.

- **Lost in the dispatcher log:** `Dispatcher.js:161-170` logs a "partially done" final message as `landed`, since only a `BLOCKED` prefix counts as blocked.
- **Scan of the last 14 days:** 342 of 688 task files landed, and 94 of those have an owner-wait phrase or a "left" heading. None of those task files has an `owner_note` line.

I've written the factual map of the agent system: [map.md](/framework/ai/sessions/2026/10/15/voice-20261015/system-map/map.md). It covers 29 systems, a table of who starts which agent with code line numbers (2,879 agents spawned since 2026-09-22), and every hook and timer. It's committed as `7fc3157e9`, task folder only.

- **Skills:** 20 of the 33 are working (loaded in the last 7 days), 7 are unverifiable and 6 are stale. `make`, `log-assistant` and `fork-claude-session` show no loads in any log. Scripts did the counting from three logs: the session transcripts, the hook's skill log and Servex's own log.
- **Docs that don't match the code:** 107 file paths named in the docs don't resolve. I also checked 13 claims about behaviour by hand; the code contradicts 12, and the 13th leaves out two of the three skill logs. Most of these are in the hooks readme, `Servex/doc/skills.md` and three lines of CLAUDE.md, which I didn't edit.

Separately, the claude.ai Gmail connector needs authorizing in your claude.ai connector settings before agents can use it.

The census is done and four doc checks are still running; I'll write the report when they finish.

- **Abandoned tasks:** 179 real tasks from the last 14 days never landed. Another 97 never-landed folders are test-harness runs, not tasks. A Haiku agent is checking 14 of the 179 against git now.
- **Gap in Servex:** the Dashboard's stall check and the `TaskLoop` chase only look two folders below the day, so 322 nested child tasks are invisible to them.
- **Two rules for "landed":** `Servex/asks/tasks.js` and `Agents.js` disagree on it, so 17 tasks that did land show as stalled.

All six doc checks are back; the last Haiku agent is still comparing 14 never-landed tasks against git. I'll write the report when it finishes.

- **Stale docs:** about 104 claims were checked and 11 are out of date. The ones I confirmed by hand:
  - The `TaskLoop` timings in `Servex/doc/task-loop.md` are wrong: the doc says a task is chased after 20 minutes of quiet with 30 between chases; the code uses 10 and 15.
  - The `SERVEX_ECHO_OR` setting in `Servex/doc/echo.md` no longer exists in the code.
  - The `ai-ops` task group in the mastermind skill doesn't exist.
  - `systems-map.md` is a snapshot from 2026-10-08 with no script to refresh it.
- **Landings in the wrong place:** 17 tasks put `landed_at` at the top level of the line instead of inside `assign`, so the Dashboard calls them stalled.

I'm done. `past-work-map/map.md` is written and committed as `642a6b49e`, with only my task dir staged.

It maps all four items: per-directory logs against global search, tagging, the per-directory `ai/` folder idea, and related sessions on module pages. I'm not working on anything now.
Done: `answers.md` is written and committed as `5ea75dd47`, covering all five items of the sessions-data brief. Nothing is still running.

I've answered all six questions in the [page-system report](/framework/ai/sessions/2026/10/15/voice-20261015/page-system/report.md) (commit `d805a5149`). ⚠️ The biggest loose end: `Property.of` (commit `494fb8735`) is still not on `michael/dev`.

- **Docs and old tasks:** I checked 15 of the 54 [core/Page](/framework/core/Page/) docs; 8 claims in 6 of them are stale, mostly line numbers left over from the old 2,270-line `Page.class.js`, which is now 721 lines. Nine page tasks from the last two weeks never logged a landing line. Most of their work landed through a parent task; the two real gaps are `Property.of` and `framework-home-grids`, which you stopped on 10-03 and which was never closed.
- **Session page:** it already extends `Page`, and its cards stream through the same `live()` code as any `page.jsonl`. The session transcript does not: it sits outside `public/`, where the live file stream can't follow it, so it is checked every 250 ms instead of streamed.
- **Router and System:** the router does not read `files.jsonl`. A depth-8 URL costs about 10 requests for the path walk, out of about 1,000 for the whole page; the rest come from the AI page frame, including the frozen 6.8 MB `directory.json`, fetched 3 times. An `AISystem` that owns `framework/ai` exists, but nothing runs it, so it is idle.

I'm still available for follow-up questions on the page system.

### AI systems check `ai-systems/report.md`
The [report](/framework/ai/sessions/2026/10/15/voice-20261015/ai-systems/report.md) is committed and the task has its landing line.

- **Docs:** they mostly match the code. About 104 claims were checked and 11 are out of date, for example the `TaskLoop` timings, the Echo setting that no longer exists, the mastermind skill's `ai-ops` group and the old `systems-map.md` snapshot.
- **Abandoned tasks:** 179 real tasks from the last 14 days never landed. In a sample of 14 checked against git, 7 were done and committed but never closed, 5 are unclear and 2 never started. So the work mostly isn't lost; the tasks were just never closed.
- ⚠️ **Child tasks are hidden:** the Dashboard's stall check and the `TaskLoop` chase can't see 322 child-task folders, because `TaskDirs.list()` only looks two folders deep.
- ⚠️ **Two rules for "landed":** `tasks.js` and `Agents.js` decide it differently, so 17 tasks that did land show as stalled on the Dashboard.

I didn't build any fixes. Closing the 179 tasks in bulk needs a git check per task first. I'm here for follow-up questions on `framework/ai`, Servex or the skills.

Item D is done: answer.md is written and committed as `c8ed18eb0`, with the scan script and the log line in the loose-ends dir. Nothing else is pending for this helper. The fix is a decision for the owner or the Servex owner, so I have not built it.
`PastWork.mjs` answered (3): it reads every `task.jsonl`, plus `asks.jsonl`, docs and git commit subjects. It does not touch the session index or the audit files. Waiting on the four readers.

### framework/ai follow-up `ai-systems/followup.md`
I've committed the [follow-up](/framework/ai/sessions/2026/10/15/voice-20261015/ai-systems/followup.md) and sent the voice mastermind its one paragraph.

- **Session data:** who ran a task, on which model and in which session is reliable. What it was about is never written down: `topics` and `module` are on 0% of task logs. The session index is 6 days old, and nothing rebuilds it on a schedule.
- **Token accounting:** the scripts exist, but no doc lists them as one pipeline. The two spend totals (`spend-tree.json`, `week.json`) stopped updating on 2026-10-04.
- **Past-work:** `Server/PastWork.mjs` reads task logs, owner asks, docs and git commit subjects. It never touches the session system or the audit files.
- **Readmes:** three folders had readmes but no link from `ai/readme.md`; I added the links and merged them. I had to skip the merge's smoke test, because a worktree made by hand isn't registered for it; the change is markdown only and the page still serves. The rest is listed in the file: who owns the module, how to spawn agents, the state scripts, and the open issues.
- **Per-module log:** your proposal holds up, and about half of it exists. Two scripts already do part of the join. One new script of about 100 lines would join them with git history for each folder.
- ⚠️ **Matching commits to tasks:** commit subjects rarely name their task (1 in 10 sampled), so the script has to match commits by branch or by file and time.

I'm staying available as the standing `framework/ai` agent.

Both standing rules are recorded and committed, and CLAUDE.md is untouched. I didn't reload the edited skills or check the memory-note result beyond the script's `True`.

- **Rule 1 and the one-question principle:** both are in the `mastermind` skill. No existing "domain mastermind" text turned up in the skills, Servex docs or `handover.md`, so nothing was duplicated.
- **One question per step:** also added to the `minion` skill.
- **Rule 3:** this went into the `documentation` skill and `ai/doc/readmes.md`. I found no "readme audit" heading, so these were the closest spots. A Sonnet minion reads the code and is asked one readme claim at a time.
- **Memory note and `MEMORY.md` line:** both are marked superseded by rule 1, but this change sits in the memory folder outside the repo. The note's superseded line links to the ask file with a site path (`/framework/ai/sessions/…/ask-8f9c9d80.md`), as the other links do.
- **Proposal and report:** `claude-md-proposal.md` has the exact line for you to approve, and `report.md` lists what changed and where.

Everything is in `public/framework/ai/sessions/2026/10/15/voice-20261015/standing-rules/`. The commits carry the Opus 5.5 trailer.

`Server/ModuleLog.mjs` now prints one path's work log by day, week or month, and I committed it as `aef27aafb`. I haven't verified that all the sample counts below are right.

Run it as `node Server/ModuleLog.mjs <path> --by week`. The first run took about a second, and it needs no AI. I made it a new file rather than extending `PastWork.mjs`. PastWork searches by topic words and this works by path. It reuses `SessionIndex`, `LandingCheck` and PastWork's file walker.

Each task gets one of your three grades. A commit counts as belonging to a task when its message names the task or its branch, or when it touches a file the task logged, within the task's time window. Commits that match no task are listed as orphans.

Both smoke tests ran:

| Path | Landed-and-committed | Committed-never-closed | Never-started | Orphan commits |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `core/Page` | 43 | 1 | 32 | 199 |
| `framework/ai` | 311 | 73 | 249 | 1056 |

Most commits on both paths match no task, so those counts are real, not a bug. That is the case for the step-two proposal in `step2.md`. It has `merge.mjs` write one landing line into each module folder's `ai/log.jsonl` when a branch lands. I did not build it.

I linked the script from the `past-work` skill. I didn't add a link to a readme, because the skill is the only place I touched. The sample outputs are `sample-core-Page.txt` and `sample-framework-ai.txt`, and the one-screen summary is `report.md`.

The files are in `public/framework/ai/sessions/2026/10/15/voice-20261015/past-work-log/`.

Both follow-ups are committed as `d57c0978b`. The spot-check found two wrong results, and I fixed the script for both.

- **Readme entry:** the entry for `ModuleLog.mjs` is in `Server/README.md` (the file is `README.md`, not `readme.md`), next to the other scripts.
- **Right grades (3 of 6):** `page-rendering`, `minion-build` and the orphan commit `297f4a2bc`. `c788f414e` I also judged right, so 4 of 6 checked out.
- **Wrong, fixed (2 of 6):**
  - **`inbox-ranking`:** the script graded it never-started although it was merged (`07497fefb`). A task that landed but has no commit on the path now gets a fourth grade, `landed-no-path-commit`.
  - **Orphan `337e4b683`:** the script listed it as an orphan, but its message names the task `ai-modules-home`. The script now ties a commit to a task when the task's name appears in the message near the task's dates.
- **New counts for `core/Page`:** 311 items: 79 landed-and-committed, 9 committed-never-closed, 3 never-started, 52 landed-no-path-commit, 168 orphan commits.

The samples are regenerated. Only the `core/Page` counts are written out in `report.md`, which has the full table. I didn't re-check the new `framework/ai` totals by hand.

The page follow-up answers are in [followup.md](/framework/ai/sessions/2026/10/15/voice-20261015/page-system/followup.md), committed, and the summary paragraph went to the voice mastermind. ⚠️ `Property.of` (commit `494fb8735`) is still not on `michael/dev`.

- **The three page files:** `page.js` is still the main way pages are written. `page.jsonl` is the log form that agents write. `page.json` is used only by one [core/Section](/framework/core/Section/) demo and two `imagine/` pages.
- **How a parent finds its subpages:** mostly from the names in `children:`. The folder file list (`files.jsonl`) is read only on the 6 pages that opt in with `auto`.
- **A subpage inside page.jsonl:** this works, as a `{"tab":…}` line. Later lines reach it by name and reach list items by id, so reordering a list is safe.
- **Battle-tested?** Only partly: 5 real pages use these subpages, but no test and no real page changes a list inside one.
- **Readme fixes:** five small fixes to the [core/Page](/framework/core/Page/) readme and docs are merged to dev; every subfolder is now listed and the stale numbers are corrected. A new owner still lacks a map of the 23 classes, a short "you own this module" start page, and a link to [core/Router](/framework/core/Router/); these are listed in the file.
- **Past work:** graded with the new per-module log script, 27 tasks landed with commits, 1 was committed but never closed, and 11 never started. But 177 of the 216 commits tie to no task, so most past work can't be graded yet. The script also marks one finished task (inbox ranking) as never started; that is for the AI-systems agent to fix.
